meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能用ETE 4读写Newick等树文件，进行修剪、定根等编辑，比较拓扑差异，检测基因树进化事件，并渲染成PDF/SVG图片。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理系统发育树，如读写Newick文件、编辑树拓扑、比较差异等时触发；不要用它从原始序列推断树。

say.text: 帮我读取tree.nw，按中点重新定根。
say.note: 调用ETE加载并应用中点定根。

say.text: 把这个基因树按进化事件标注，输出PDF。
say.note: 检测复制/分化事件并生成带标注的图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use ETE 4 to read/write Newick files, edit trees (prune, reroot), compare topologies, detect gene-tree evolutionary events, and render trees as PDF/SVG images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to process phylogenetic trees, such as Newick/NHX I/O, topology edits, or tree comparison. Not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Load tree.nw and reroot it at the midpoint.
say_en.note: Loads the tree and applies midpoint rooting.

say_en.text: Compute the Robinson-Foulds distance between these two trees.
say_en.note: Returns the distance and shared leaf count.

say_en.text: Annotate this gene tree by evolutionary events and render it to PDF.
say_en.note: Detects events and outputs an annotated figure.
